sections.description: SONOREX DIGITEC DT product information: SweepTec technology, heated vs unheated models, and accessory options.
sections.subheading: Why uniform cavitation matters more than raw power
body: SweepTec runs fully automatically on every unit in the range, actively preventing standing waves in the ultrasonic field so cleaning stays even across the entire tank rather than concentrated in certain zones.
A membrane keypad sets cleaning time directly, with the remaining time shown clearly on the display throughout the cycle.

Heated models add bath temperature setting alongside cleaning time, with the display showing both the set and actual temperature so you can confirm the bath has actually reached target before starting a sensitive cycle.

The Degas function activates at the start of a cleaning cycle, removing dissolved gas from the liquid first to sharpen the ultrasound's cleaning effect from the outset rather than losing early cycle time to gas removal happening passively.

Internal tank dimensions span from compact bench units to genuinely large workshop tanks, letting you match tank size to the objects you're actually cleaning rather than over- or under-buying capacity.

Matching baskets, lids, and cleaning or disinfection concentrates are available as coordinated accessories, so the bath, basket, and chemistry work together rather than being sourced separately and hoped to fit.
Construction across the range carries a reputation for particular robustness, built for repeated daily use in labs, workshops, and clinical practice settings alike.

sections.title: SweepTec and Degas Explained
sections.description: An ultrasonic bath is only as good as how evenly its cavitation reaches the whole tank, and that's exactly what these two functions are built to solve. Standing waves form naturally in a fixed-frequency ultrasonic field, creating pockets of intense cavitation next to nearly dead zones in the same tank. SweepTec actively varies the field to prevent that pattern from settling in, so cleaning stays consistent whether an object sits in the center of the tank or against the wall. The Degas function tackles a separate problem: dissolved gas in the cleaning liquid absorbs some of the ultrasound's energy before it ever reaches the object being cleaned. Running Degas at the start of a cycle clears that dissolved gas out first, so the ultrasound works at full effect from the very beginning rather than only reaching peak performance partway through.

sections.title: Heated vs Unheated Models
sections.description: Not every cleaning or degassing process needs temperature control, and the range splits cleanly along that line.
body: Unheated models, like DT 31, DT 52, DT 510, and DT 514, focus on cleaning time control and the display of remaining time, suited to processes where ambient or unheated liquid temperature is enough. Heated models, marked with an H or CH designation such as DT 31 H, DT 255 H, and DT 1028 CH, add bath temperature setting through the same membrane keypad, with the display showing both the set and actual temperature so you can confirm the bath has genuinely reached target conditions before relying on it for a temperature-sensitive process.
